reference.title: Best Practices for Updating Software
reference.shortdesc: Best practices and benefits of staying up-to-date with software and system updates.

section.title: Best Practices
section.p: To stay up-to-date with your software and operating systems, you should understand the following practices and how they benefit you by protecting your data.

strow.stentry: Operate with up-to-date technology without needing constant reminders.
Address updates with solutions to known vulnerabilities and keep your system and data secure.
Informs you and keeps your data safe from security issues, breaches, and cybersecurity attacks on institutional and personal technology.
